video.accountName: 豆苗妈妈（口语娃启蒙方法）
video.title: 在车上到底是 in 还是 on 呢？ #英语启蒙 #双语宝宝 #英语牛娃 #豆苗妈妈口语娃启蒙
video.scriptRefined:
In a train. We're on a train.  
In a taxi. We're on a taxi.

让我告诉你一个方法，保证每次都能选对。  
如果你能站着走上去，那就用“on”。  
你登上飞机（get on a plane），  
你登上火车（get on a train），  
你登上巴士（get on a bus）。

如果你需要弯下腰、缩着身子进去，那就用“in”。  
你坐进车里（get in the car），  
你坐进出租车（get in a taxi），  
你坐进直升机（get in a helicopter）。

嗯，以后你再也不用纠结这个问题了。  
明白了吗？嗯？

We're on a taxi.Let me tell you how to know the correct answerevery single time.If you can walk onto the vehiclestanding up on your feet,then it's on. You get on a plane,you get on a train, you get on a bus.If you have to crouch down and get in the vehicle,you have to make yourself smaller.You get in the vehicle,you get in the car,you get in a taxi, you get in a helicopter.Hmm. You never have to think about it ever again.Do you get it? Huh?
